type: threshold sensitivity of the near-degenerate tier, and exercise the previously untested ratio branch

why_false_positives_matter_most: a check that cries wolf gets ignored, and an ignored check protects nothing

honest_gap.what: the ratio thresholds were not discriminated
honest_gap.why: the scale-shrink construction multiplies by 0.01, which is below all three candidate cuts, so all three detect it
honest_gap.status: the branch works; the cut value is chosen, not derived
